title: Artinian versality of a proper algebraic-space curve family
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], let $T$ be an $S$-scheme, let $x$ be a proper algebraic-space curve family over $T$ as in [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli], and let $u\in T$, with residue field $k=\kappa(u)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Say that $x$ is versal at $u$ if the following holds. For every surjection $q:A'\to A$ of commutative Artinian local rings in the big site's universe, with nilpotent kernel, and every surjection $r:A\to k$ (identifying the residue field of $A$ with $k$, and that of $A'$ by $rq$), choose any $s':\operatorname{Spec}A'\to S$ and any $S$-morphism $a:\operatorname{Spec}A\to T$ with $a\operatorname{Spec}(r)$ the canonical residue-field morphism at $u$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every curve family $Y$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A'$, every curve family $Z$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, and maps $j:Z\to Y$, $z:Z\to x$ whose squares over $\operatorname{Spec}(q)$ and $a$ respectively are cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], there exist an $S$-morphism $b:\operatorname{Spec}A'\to T$ with $b\operatorname{Spec}(q)=a$ and a cartesian map $w:Y\to x$ over $b$ with $wj=z$. The cartesian maps specify the isomorphism of the reduction of $Y$ with the pullback of $x$, and the last equality requires extension of that specified isomorphism. No choice of a coefficient field inside either Artinian ring is part of the data.
